svg.title: RIEMANN-MASULLO-DIAGRAMS C11 — Chapter 11 · Ch11_ShellStructure, item by item
svg.desc: riemann-masullo at 72a10ff: 52 items in 14 modules, 993 declarations. 0 open, 3 resting on an open declaration, 49 proved. 36 items have a declaration that states something other than the print; 73 errata entries are on them.

svg.text: riemann-masullo at 72a10ff: 52 items in 14 modules, 993 declarations. 0 open, 3 resting on an open declaration, 49 proved. 36 items have a declaration that states something other than the print; 73 errata entries are on them.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Posters: M1, what the targets rest on · M2, the steps with no known repair · M3, the paper by depth · M4, every chapter · M5, the refutations. Names, items, files, entries and posters are links, underlined under the pointer: a card's title or a Lean name opens the source at the pin.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How to read it. One band per module of the directory, one card per paper item: the declarations whose docstrings cite it, and the helpers before them in the same file, as riemann-masullo's progress map groups them. “Uses” and “Used by” name the items of this directory whose declarations a card's declarations use directly, with each

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: use that another path between the same items already implies left out. Uses of other directories are counted, not named. A use is what the elaborated terms reach at the pin, a fact about the Lean and not about the paper. Errata are ERRATA.md's entries, placed by the item numbers their “Where” column names, with their Checked

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: value and nothing stronger. They were reported and checked by AI agents; in ERRATA.md's words, “No entry has been reviewed by a specialist.”

svg.text: What this does not say. Nothing was built or proved by this repository: the declarations and their uses are read from riemann-masullo's compiled library at the pin. A card says what the Lean holds for an item, not that the item is right. Item numbers and pages are the Lean docstrings'; the manuscript is not read. “Deviating from the print” counts declarations
